critical_code_review_comments: RestaurantWorkspacesP6.jsx is a growing file — verify size; if >700 LOC consider extracting CookModeModal into its own file (it's already a full sub-component with regex parser + timer).
Cost heuristic uses 4 chars/token — good rough approximation; consider revisiting when Anthropic exposes actual token counts via API for accuracy.

parseStepMinutes regex 'for X min[utes]' correctly matched 'Simmer for 15 minutes' — good; consider also supporting 'X sec[onds]' and combined 'X min Y sec' in a future iter (out of scope).
